title: Variable-Frequency Second-Order Filter
text: 离散时间或连续时间变频二阶滤波器，输入 2 路、输出 1 路；按 {Filter type} 指定滤波器类型；{Initial natural frequency (Hz)} 指定初始自然频率、{Damping factor} 指定阻尼因子、{Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间、{Initial amplitude} 指定初始幅值、{Initial phase (rad)} 指定初始相位、{Initial frequency (Hz)}、{Initial bias} 指定初始偏置，按实例取值。

params.name: Filter type
params.values: 滤波器类型 Low-pass (default) | High-pass | Band-pass | Band-stop

params.name: Initial natural frequency (Hz)
params.values: 初始自然频率 60 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: 模块采样时间 -1 (default) | 0 | positive scalar
